extracted.summary: Layla Haddad is looking to buy a home with a 3.5M max budget, needing at least 3 bedrooms, a pool and covered parking for 2 cars; her husband Karim must approve any purchase, a viewing is confirmed for 14 March at 11am, and she is worried about service charges in some towers. Layla Haddad needs a ready-to-move-in home with covered parking for 2 cars and a home study, has a lease renewal deadline of 15/04/2026 and her current lease ends 30 June 2026; the rep committed to following up with the developer about the payment plan. Layla is house-hunting with her husband Karim: she needs a home study and a proper kitchen, Karim wants nothing above the 20th floor, and they may need a ground floor room for his mother; the down payment depends on her December bonus. Mostly routine exchanges with Layla Haddad; she is looking for 2-3 options in Arabian Ranches, raised a past developer's 18-month-late handover as a concern, dislikes beige kitchens, will be away in February, and will sign if the bank approves by end of month; the rep promised to send a snagging checklist before handover. Mostly routine back-and-forth with Layla Haddad over listings; she conditionally agreed to sign if the bank approves financing by end of month, said she'd decide after Eid, flagged a preference against crowded areas and for proximity to the airport due to her husband Karim's travel, mentioned her sister Rania is also house-hunting near the Marina, and complained that their current 180k/year rent feels wasteful. Layla is currently paying 180k a year in rent and finds it wasteful, her daughter Noor starts KG2 in September making the school run a factor, and her dad is helping with the down payment and wants to view the property. Layla will get a valuation report from the bank, and the rep will confirm landlord details by Wednesday. Mostly low-content exchanges with Layla; the rep promised to confirm with the landlord by Wednesday, Layla mentioned talking to another agent, disliked a dark property and one near a noisy highway, noted Karim wants a building with a gym, and her colleague is also looking for a 2-bed. Mostly low-content exchanges with Layla Haddad about property listings; she wants to close before 1 September 2026, has a budget of 3.5 (stretchable to 3.8 per Karim), mentioned her mum's 60th birthday on 2 October and her colleague's interest in a 2-bed, and the rep promised to introduce her to his mortgage broker this week. Long chat exchange with Layla Haddad with many listings sent; key updates were a concern about lack of shade at a Damac Hills property, a shift to needing 4 bedrooms instead of 3 because Karim's mum is moving in, and background that they bought their first flat in JVC in 2019 and Karim's contract here ends next summer. Mostly low-content back-and-forth with Layla Haddad; her space requirement changed from 3 to 4 bedrooms because Karim's mum is moving in, she later added a studio investment requirement for Karim's mum, and she joked sarcastically about a 5M price being unaffordable. Layla wants a small studio as an investment for Karim's mum, and the rep shared several listings over the following weeks; Layla noted she will be away from 1 to 20 December 2026. Mostly routine exchanges and listing links between Sam and Layla; the rep committed to checking the pool depth, sending the service charge history, and booking Karim's second viewing, and Layla shared Karim's birthday and their anniversary dates along with a hedged note that they may decide by year end. Mostly low-content chat exchanges with Layla Haddad; a meeting was proposed for Thursday 12 November 2026 at 4pm with no confirmation, and Layla mentioned Karim expects a decision by the end of the year, though uncertain.
